title: Pakistan: Updated Nationally Determined Contributions 2021
organization: Government of Pakistan, Ministry of Climate Change
temporal_coverage: National climate vulnerability and adaptation planning in the 2021 NDC, with projections through the 2050s.
methodology: Government NDC with climate-impact, socioeconomic, and adaptation chapters.
limitations: National synthesis; projection uncertainties vary across cited analyses.

title: Pakistan Floods 2022: Post-Disaster Needs Assessment Main Report
organization: Government of Pakistan, with Asian Development Bank, European Union, United Nations Development Programme, and World Bank support
temporal_coverage: Assessment of the June–August 2022 floods; data collected September to mid-October 2022.
methodology: Government-led PDNA triangulating agency and remote-sensing inputs during September–October 2022.
limitations: Rapid assessment during an ongoing disaster; inaccessible areas limit accuracy.

title: Balochistan Climate Change Policy
organization: Government of Balochistan and UNDP Pakistan
temporal_coverage: Provincial climate risks and 2022 flood/fire impacts discussed in a 2024 policy.
methodology: Provincial policy developed with consultations across districts and sectoral planning.
limitations: Policy synthesis, not an independent impact evaluation; recommendations are not evaluated capacity.

title: Health Emergency Situation Report: Monsoon Floods, 25 July 2025
organization: World Health Organization, Regional Office for the Eastern Mediterranean
temporal_coverage: Monsoon and flash-flood impacts and health response reported as of 25 July 2025.
methodology: Operational snapshot drawing on NDMA totals, PMD forecasts and health-sector reporting.
limitations: Single-date situation update; early impact and response figures are not final outcome estimates.

title: Pakistan: Acute Food Insecurity Analysis, December 2025–September 2026
organization: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) Analysis Unit, Pakistan
temporal_coverage: Analysis covers observed acute food insecurity in December 2025–March 2026; its April–September 2026 projection period had elapsed by this extraction.
methodology: Current-period classification used a household Food Security and Livelihood Assessment from September–November 2025 and secondary sources.
limitations: 45 districts were covered, fewer than the previous 68; this finding is historical.
